title: Eleven Objects and a Stopwatch
subtitle: 引力物理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 引力物理（宇宙探索·引力与物理）
meta: 主题语境：引力物理（宇宙探索·引力与物理）　|　核心词汇：rate　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rate 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In the autumn of 1998 I dropped eleven objects from the top of the science block and timed them, which is an experiment every child does and nobody believes until they have done it. They fell at the same ① rate — the brick and the feather in its tube, the heavy one and the light one — and two of the class never accepted it, because the rate is not what anybody expects. What we were really measuring was the ② rate of change of speed, which I did not understand until years later.

Mr Anand, who taught us, said the ③ rate of fall is the only number in physics that does not care what is falling, and that this is either the most boring fact in the subject or the most extraordinary, depending on how long you look at it. He said ④ at any rate we should write it down, because in forty years we would not believe ourselves.

I have thought about that class more than any other. At the ⑤ rate I was going that year I would have failed everything, and Mr Anand knew it. He gave me the eleven objects and the stopwatch instead of a detention, which I have never forgotten and never thanked him for.

He retired in 2003. The ⑥ rate of pay for a teacher, he said, had not moved in nine years, and he had never once asked for it to. What he did mind was the ⑦ rate at which the school replaced its equipment: eleven microscopes in 1990, four in 1998, none by the time he left.

The ⑧ failure rate in his last class was eleven per cent and he was ashamed of it, which I found out only recently and which I do not understand. At the ⑨ rate the county was closing schools, his would have gone in 2009 whether he had taught well or badly. He died in 2011, and the thing I most want to tell somebody is that he was a ⑩ first-rate teacher who was ashamed of an eleven per cent failure rate.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 速率；速度（at a rate of ...）
B. n. 比率；率（the failure rate）
C. n. 价格；费率；报酬标准（the rate of pay）
D. 固定搭配：at any rate 无论如何；至少
E. 固定搭配：at this / that rate 照这样（下去）
F. 固定搭配：rate of change 变化率
G. 固定搭配：the rate of fall ……的下落速率
H. adj. 一流的；优秀的（a first-rate teacher）

items.q: They fell at the same rate
the rate of change of speed
the rate of fall is the only number
He said at any rate we should write it down
At the rate I was going that year
The rate of pay for a teacher
the rate at which the school replaced its equipment
The failure rate in his last class
At the rate the county was closing schools

answers.why: at the same rate 意为“以相同的速率”，砖块和羽毛下落得一样快。
rate of change 意为“变化率”，我们真正测的是速度的变化率。
the rate of fall 意为“下落速率”，Mr Anand 说它是物理学里唯一不管下落物是什么的数字。
at any rate 意为“无论如何、至少”，他说无论如何也要把这个结果记下来。
at the rate ... 意为“照……的速度／照这样下去”，照我那一年的状态，门门都会不及格。
the rate of pay 意为“报酬标准、薪资水平”，教师的薪水九年没动过。
the rate at which ... 意为“……的速度”，指学校更换设备的速度。
the failure rate 意为“不及格率、失败率”，他最后一届学生有百分之十一不及格。
at the rate ... 意为“照……的速度”，照县里关学校的速度，他所在的学校 2009 年就会没。
first-rate 意为“一流的、优秀的”，说他是一位一流的老师。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 它们以相同的速率下落。（rate）
我们真正测量的是速度的变化率。（rate of change）
下落速率是物理学里唯一不关心下落物是什么的数字。（rate of fall）
不管怎样，我们应该把这个结果记下来。（at any rate）
照我那一年的状态下去，我门门都会不及格。（at the rate ...）
answers: They fell at the same rate.
What we were really measuring was the rate of change of speed.
The rate of fall is the only number in physics that does not care what is falling.
At any rate, we should write it down.
At the rate I was going that year, I would have failed everything.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 rate 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In the autumn of 1998 I dropped eleven objects from the top of the science block and timed them.
They fell at the same rate — the brick and the feather in its tube — though what we were really measuring was the rate of change of speed.
Mr Anand said the rate of fall is the only number in physics that does not care what is falling, and told us to write it down at any rate.
At the rate I was going that year I would have failed everything, and he gave me the stopwatch instead of a detention.
He minded the rate at which the school replaced its equipment far more than the rate of pay.
He was a first-rate teacher, and he was ashamed of an eleven per cent failure rate.
